messages:
Ava (CEO): quick follow-up from today's all-hands on strategy/positioning. i'll hang for 15 mins to take concise q's about mission, market, and competitors.
Liam (Sales): for one-pagers, should we lead with 'cost' or 'reliability'?
Maya (Head of Strategy): lead with reliability/ops for mid-market, cost for scale-ups. both are valid; phrase as 'predictable latency & predictable cost'.
Chris (VP Product): clarify: when we say 'unified runtime' customers expect same API across hosted/dedicated/private, right?
Ava (CEO): correct. single API + ops surface. internally we may route to different optimized runtimes but customers see one contract.
Diego (Eng): competitor question: how blunt can we be comparing to big infra vendors in external content?
Ava (CEO): be factual and feature-focused externally; internal sales can be candid. point to differences: rollouts, token-level cost, private integrations.
Liam (Sales): short battlecard line we can use?
Maya (Head of Strategy): "Redwood Inference: the production platform for running LLMs with predictable latency, lower unit costs, and enterprise controls across any infrastructure."
OpsBot: notice: all-hands-notes uploaded at 1765967055 by OpsBot
Ava (CEO): i'll drop this into marketing + sales channels. book time with maya/chris for deeper dives. thanks everyone.
